customers_say: Customers find the door lock to be of good quality, with solid build and easy installation that takes about 5 minutes with the phone app. They appreciate its appearance, features, and ease of use, with one customer highlighting its multiple access options including fingerprint and passcode entry. The functionality receives mixed reviews - while many say it works well, some report issues with the front lock not working and the fingerprint scanner stopping unexpectedly. Value for money opinions are also mixed, with some considering it a good buy while others advise against purchasing it.
